mentions.name: Rabbet Joinery Box DXF Generator
mentions.description: Small apps built with Flet that generate DXF files for CNC projects with drawn previews. Currently at a working state for rabbet joinery boxes with a sliding lid or with the lid omitted; a hinged lid option and a more accurate-looking wireframe preview are planned next.
mentions.source_excerpt: Since the 1.0 announcement for flet.dev I have been working on making small apps to make DXF files for CNC projects with drawn previews.
